variant_traps.agent_rule: Compare Japanese text layout line-by-line against a known Expansion Pack exemplar before treating the No Rarity claim as clean.
evidence_request: full front image with readable Japanese text
lower-right rarity-symbol crop with surrounding border
text-area close-up sharp enough for line breaks and spacing
known Expansion Pack exemplar or verifier note if value or trust gap is material
variant_traps.name: Quick Starter Gift Set text-layout trap
not_claiming: not proof of Quick Starter origin
not proof of Expansion Pack origin
not proof that a grading label is correct
variant_traps.risk: This Trainer has no-symbol lookalikes outside the Expansion Pack claim path. A missing rarity mark alone can be misleading.
